chattabs.config.title: Chat Tabs – Settings
chattabs.config.closed.tooltip: Whether the tabs are also shown while the chat is closed. "When unread" only shows them while a blinking tab has unread messages.
chattabs.config.pm_close.tooltip: Closes all PM tabs when you leave the server.
chattabs.config.history.tooltip: How many messages are kept in total (vanilla: 100). All tabs share this storage.
chattabs.config.pm_pattern.tooltip: Regular expression for private messages. The player name must be in the group (?<player>...); use (?<player2>...), (?<player3>...) etc. for more alternatives.
chattabs.config.pm_command.tooltip: What is sent when you type in a PM tab. {player} = player, {message} = your message. Empty = send normally. Commands (starting with /) are never changed.
chattabs.config.col.name: Name
chattabs.config.type.tooltip:
System: everything not assigned to a channel or PM tab.
Channel: messages matching the filter (first matching channel wins).
All: shows every message.
chattabs.config.pattern.tooltip:
Regular expression on the message text without colors. Example for "[Freebuild] [G] Name: text":
^(?:\[[^\]]+\] )?\[G\]
chattabs.config.prefix.tooltip: Put in front of your message when typing in this tab, e.g. "/g ". Empty = send normally.
chattabs.config.blink.tooltip: Tab blinks while it has unread messages.
chattabs.config.reset.tooltip: Resets tabs, PM detection and PM command to the defaults (applied after "Save").
